column2: Today’s position. Booking = parcels in. Pay out = carrier bills & expenses. Parties = consignors & carriers.
Party id is unique (names may repeat). Roles: Consignor (AR), Carrier (AP), or both on that id. Ledgers stay separate; reports show net.

Receiver of the parcel. Leave blank for walk-in counter drop-offs.

Update the app — this device and the office server have different versions
Printers are set on the shop device (Server). This till sends jobs there — Find / add / assign stay on the Server. Test page goes to the Server.
Tap Find printers for queues that accept jobs and network receipt printers on this Wi‑Fi (not removed or offline ones).

Optional. If this PIN is typed at unlock instead of yours, all books entries are wiped (bookings, ledgers, history) and the desk opens as Owner looking normal — rates, parties, zones, staff and settings stay. Schema and config are not deleted. Use only if you are forced to unlock. Leave blank and save to turn off. Never the same as anyone's PIN.

On this device (Server): Other devices → Allow extra tills. Note the pairing code and Wi‑Fi address. Tap Allow other devices to connect if it appears. On a computer, tap Start with this computer. On each other device: install the app, choose Client Mode, Find the shop's server (or type the address), enter the pairing code, Pair now. Orders wait on the device if Wi‑Fi drops and go when the Server answers again.

How parcels are measured at the booking desk. Type dimensions and weight in the units you use — standard (cm, m, in, ft · kg, g, lb, oz) or your own unit linked to cm / kg above (directly or through other units). Books always record kg. Leave a field empty to keep it.
Type how much in each (cash / UPI / card / credit). Must add up to the bill. Credit needs a customer above.
དངུལ་གཉེར་པ། བཙོང་། འགན་འཛིན། བཙོངས་ + དཀར་ཆག་རྣམ་གྲངས་ + སྟོང་ཆ་/བཅོས་སྒྲིག
This app is Moklanjo only — books + booking desk. Other trade faces ship as separate products later.

Owner only — same choices as Windows uninstall. Business records clears trading history but keeps rates and setup (like the emergency unlock PIN). Shop setup removes the books database. Screen preferences clears window/language. Confirm with the Owner PIN. The emergency unlock PIN on Team is separate (covert wipe at unlock).

གླས་པ། ལས་ཀ་ཞིག་འདེམས་པ། (དངུལ་གཉེར་པ/སྤྱི་གཉེར་བ་)། མིང་+ འགོ་འཛུགས་ཀྱི་PIN དེ་ནས་ཁ་སྣོན་བྱེད་དགོས།མི་འདི་མི་འདྲ་བ་ཡོད་ན། གཤམ་གྱི་བརྙན་ཤེལ་དང་དབང་ཆ་ཁ་ཕྱེ་ན། དེ་ནས་ལས་གནས་སྒྲིག་སྟངས་ཉར་ཚགས་བྱེད་དགོས།མི་རེ་རེ་ཚང་མས་གཤམ་དུ་རང་ཉིད་ཀྱི་PIN བརྗེ་དགོས། — བདག་པོས་མི་གཞན་གྱི་PIN བསྒྱུར་མི་ཐུབ།

རེའུ་མིག་རྣམ་གྲངས་ཀྱི་མཚོན་རྟགས་(ཀེ་ཇི་དང་། ཆ་ཤས། ཁུག་མ།) གཞི་གྲངས་རེ་རེ་བཞིན་ཐད་ཀར་ཡང་ན་གཞི་གྲངས་གཞན་བརྒྱུད་ནས་ཚད་གཞི་(kg · cm · ml · pc)ལ་མཐུད་དགོས། དཔེར་ན། 1 སྒམ་ = 2 སྒམ་ 1 = 20 cm. བསྒྱུར་བཅོས། 1 ནས་ = ཆ་རྐྱེན་བར། དངུལ་ལོར་ནི་ནམ་ཡང་ཚད་གཞི་མིན།
